corrections.reason: The printed glyph is 1st-order ጸ (ሐጸብኩክሙ, canonical Ge'ez perfective verb stem), not 4th-order ጻ.
Joining with እ- from the end of Line 3, the image clearly prints ግረክሙ (forming እግረክሙ, 'your feet'), not ገሪክሙ.
The initial character of አውቆ in the image is clearly አ (Alef), not ዐ (Ayin).
Both occurrences of the verb in this line use 6th-order ክ (ተወክፈ ተወክፎ), clearly showing the bent left leg of ክ in the image.
In Classical Ge'ez verb morphology, the 1st-person singular object suffix '-ni' attaches to the 1st-order stem (ያገብአኒ), and the image clearly shows 1st-order አ.
The canonical Ge'ez form is ኢያእመሩ (with 6th-order እ), which matches the indented middle stroke visible in the print.
